summary: Camp 9 (Sequoia NF, Lake Isabella): FS page + rec.gov 234011 + 2025 forest guide + alerts + Esri + 3DEP. Open; singles FCFS, 11 groups reservable; $36 + $8 extra vehicle, dump $25; March-October; 109 units, no trailer limit; vault + water. Lakefront kept with a caveat (no numbered single sites).
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront kept, with a caveat. Camp 9 is treeless open ground whose loop and shoreline roads run along the lake edge. rec.gov (the agency listing) says 'Some sites are on the lakeshore'. 3DEP puts the north loops at 2,586-2,607 ft, at or below Lake Isabella's ~2,605 ft gross pool, and the shoreline road at 35.6930,-118.4408 at 2,592 ft. At any high-water level the edge is therefore within a few tens of metres of the camping roads, over open, gently sloping ground that passes the kayak test. Named sites: reservable group sites G03 (35.69630,-118.43129), G04 (35.69687,-118.43134) and G05 (35.69760,-118.43119), which permit RVs and are sold by the night, lie ~20-60 m from the water in the high-water capture. The single family sites are unnumbered on rec.gov ('Not Reservable' placeholders, no coordinates) and are FCFS by the night, so no single site number can be cited. A reviewer applying the named-site rule strictly could take this to lakeview, but the agency's own 'on the lakeshore' wording plus open ground support a keep.

Pool caveat: USACE ran Isabella under a restricted pool for years. If the lake runs low, some shoreline sites become a long walk across bare lakebed. That does not change the call (it is measured to the high-water edge).

Facilities conflict: the FS page says 'Vault toilet(s)'; the 2025 forest guide says 'Restrooms-1 flush type ... Chemical toilets'. Wrote vault_toilets only (from the current FS page) and left flush unset.

Fee/season details: the 2025 guide gives $34 and a $20 dump fee, superseded by the current FS page and rec.gov ($36, $25 dump). The rec.gov overview calls Camp 9 'a year-round facility', but the FS season is March-October (only day use runs year-round); I followed the FS. rec.gov's 2026 rate season is 03-27 to 10-24 (group sites).
sites.max_rig_ft 40 (derived from rec.gov placeholder rows) conflicts with the forest guide's 'No limit on trailer length'. I did not write max_rig_ft; a reviewer may clear the stored 40.
